description: Lays out photovoltaic modules (or solar thermal collectors) on every roof face of the model that does not face north, with edge margins, as rows on racks on a flat roof; returns module count, area and rated power in kWp. Or removes them. Replaces an earlier layout on those faces; vedutum_undo_last_change goes back. A layout, not a yield forecast. Costs no points.

flat_roof_layout.description: Flat roof only: racks facing south (default) or east-west

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

name: vedutum_add_solar
title: Put solar modules on the roof
